The full just check otherwise passes clippy and all remaining targets. Capture JSON remains additive; implementation/docs/tests cover struck-link insertion, configured closed statuses, truthful consumed-link human/JSON output, and the fenced-index regression. No other skipped findings.

5. Cycler README/manifest 1.32.0→1.33.0; block-id-prompt 1.28.0→1.29.0; bob-cli docs in task-status-hooks.md and task-dependencies.md §13.10.
